findTheMarketWhen: Find the market when you get there.
manyMarketsHaveNo: Many markets have no sign at the roadside. Marketdey shows up to five landmarks in the order you pass them on the way in.
whenIsTheNext: When is the next market day?
everyMarketKeepsIts: Every market keeps its own rhythm. Some come round every few days, some once a week, some every day. Pick one and Marketdey does the counting.
getThisAsAn: Get this as an alert the evening before.
